import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def task_func(num_groups=5, data_size=5, labels=None):
    rng = np.random.default_rng()

    if labels is None:
        labels = [f"Group {i + 1}" for i in range(num_groups)]
    else:
        labels = list(labels)
        if len(labels) != num_groups:
            raise ValueError("Length of labels must match num_groups.")

    index = [f"Item {i + 1}" for i in range(data_size)]
    data = rng.integers(1, 11, size=(data_size, num_groups))
    df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=index, columns=labels)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    df.plot(kind="bar", stacked=True, ax=ax)

    ax.set_xlabel("Items")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_title("Stacked Bar Chart of Random Data")
    ax.legend(title="Categories", bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc="upper left")

    fig.tight_layout()
    filename = "test_plot.png"
    fig.savefig(filename, bbox_inches="tight")

    return fig, df, filename
